name: mathslop-tests
description: Tests for the mathslop extension. No dependencies; not shipped (scripts/package.sh copies only its allowlist).

scripts.test: npm run test:engine && npm run test:browser
scripts.coverage: npm run test:engine && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('coverage/browser',{recursive:true,force:true})" && MATHSLOP_COVERAGE=1 npm run test:browser && node test/tools/coverage.mjs
